status_vocabulary_note: per decision D-007: 'status' of an equation = evidence status; the result badge (calculation trust) uses verified / inferred / unresolved / not tested, and 'assumption' only when the equation itself is an engineering assumption
result_badge_rule: badge = weakest of {evidence status of every EQ in the chain, implementation test state, validity cap (violation -> unresolved)}; inputs do not enter the badge
assumptions_tag_rule: aligned with ADR-0003 decision 3 (DEF-22): the tag counts every assumed/default input the calculation actually uses plus the equation-level assumptions of its chain, list expandable, ordered by dominant_assumptions: (1) inputs whose value equals the tool default; (2) physical-property inputs not marked measured; (3) equation-level assumptions unless replaced by a measured input. Design inputs differing from the default are not listed. Membership depends on values and the measured mark only (re-typing the current value changes nothing)
input_provenance_note: 'measured' only when the user marks the value as measured and names the source/record; equation-level assumptions (e.g. PCB copper = IACS, mu_r) are listed as built-in assumed inputs until replaced by a 'measured' value
notes: status = Phase 1 evidence status of the equation; implementation status starts as 'not tested' until its tests pass in CI (ADR-0003 item 5)
gate_verdict 'replace' for EQ-04 and EQ-21 means: no Xcoil implementation exists, implement new from the specification
result status rule superseded by D-007 (DEF-02): see result_badge_rule and assumptions_tag_rule; dominant_assumptions feed the assumptions tag, not the badge

equations.name: Turn-count limits of a trapezoidal spiral coil (radial bound + constructive loop criterion)

validity_checks.name: radial edge leakage (graded)
validity_checks.metric: e_edge = sum_seg w*D_e*exp(-d/(c_e*G)) / sum_seg w; w = |B_z,1(r_m,z_L)*r_m*dr| over EMF-producing segments inside the magnet span; d = min(r_m - r_A, r_B - r_m)

parameters.G: magnet face to symmetry/iron plane (EQ-05); single rotor without yoke: magnet face to farthest copper layer (assumption)

validity_checks.basis: D09 p.4 sec. 3.1 (scalar-potential model misses radial edge leakage; B_r(r) curve-fitted from FEA, eq. 7 p.5). Calibration quantity: D09 Fig. 7 plots |B| 'at the middle of the magnet' (caption p.4, axial position not stated); EC-05 uses it as a proxy for B_z at the copper. Near the radial ends |B| contains a radial component, so the B_z deficit is at least as large: e_edge is probably a lower bound (inferred). Fit residual <= 0.02 in k; ONE calibration case -> calibration inferred
validity_checks.rule: e_edge <= 0.10: no badge cap; one-sided tolerance add-on +e_edge (model high) on Ke, EMF, torque and EMF-derived results, limitation listed; e_edge > 0.10: badge capped at unresolved
validity_checks.threshold_basis: 10 % is a design choice (D-017). The calibration case sits at 5.6-5.8 %, so 10 % allows about 1.7x extrapolation of the single-case calibration. It is not derived from the +/-8 % O1 tolerance (errors between 8 % and 10 % already exceed that band)
validity_checks.optional_correction: edge-corrected field k(d) = 1 - D_e*exp(-d/(c_e*G)), off by default; residual +/-e_edge/3 (assumption)
validity_checks.geometry_threshold_example: D09-like rotor (G 1.5 mm): cap for radial magnet length below ~12 mm (10 mm -> 12.4 %, 15 mm -> 8.4 %, 20 mm -> 6.3 %)
validity_checks.transfer_basis: scaling the decay length with G and keeping D_e = 0.47 for rotors with other magnet thickness, alpha_p, pole pitch or block/T-arrangement magnets is untested
validity_checks.independence: D09 is both the calibration source and oracle O2: O2 cannot validate EC-05. O1 (D08) is the only independent check and depends on the G10 gap reading (e_edge 4.21 % at G 1.4 mm, 5.11 % at G 1.7 mm, Agent 4 v12)

equations.name: Spiral coil centre-via eye, lead and terminal stub
equations.formula: via on the coil centre line at r_v = r_hi, m = max(pad, w)/2; r_lo = max((d_(N-1) + w/2 + s + m)/sin(pi/Q), r_end,N-1 + w_in/2 + s + m); r_hi = R_out,N-1 - w_out/2 - s - m; fits iff r_hi - r_lo >= (k - 1)(max(pad, w)/2 + pad/2 + s); lead = the last left side d_(N-1) ends at radius r_v, then one arc at r_v to the centre line (revision 2026-10-05, U-E3); half closing (revision 2026-10-05, U-E3b, k = 1, pad <= w): last turn = outer arc + right side d_(N-1) ending on the via at r_v = d_(N-1)/sin(pi/Q), used when it builds more turns than the full closing; terminal via at r_T = r_outer + s + pad/2, angle min(angle of start corner, pi/Q - asin((max(pad, bw) + s)/(2 r_T)))
equations.source_notes: geometry rules of spiral_generator_spec.md G5-G6, derived from engine.js sectorViaSpot (2269-2273) and sectorCoilX (2285-2328); the centre line is the only locus shared by layer X and its mirror Y

equations.name: Loss sum, efficiency and motor constant
equations.formula: P_loss = P_Cu + P_eddy + P_circ + P_delta,circ + P_ic; P_out = T omega_m; eta = P_out/(P_out + P_loss); K_m = T/sqrt(P_Cu)
equations.source_notes: definitions; engine.js applyConnection 1430-1434

equations.name: Numerical utilisation factor and analytic distribution factor
equations.formula: k_u = Ke1 / (sum over series conductors of integral B_z1 r dr over the magnet span) (Xcoil 'kw1'); serpentine k_d = sin(N gamma/2)/(N sin(gamma/2)), gamma = p d_alpha (radial) or p (w + s)/r_mean (parallel); wave k_d = |sum_i w_i e^{j gamma (i - (q-1)/2)}| / sum_i w_i, w_0 = 2p - 1, w_i = 2p
equations.source_notes: D15 eq. 6 p.7 (average of per-turn factors); D04 eq. 1 p.5 (distribution factor); engine.js analyze 975-986, analyzeWave 2073-2077
changes: rename Xcoil 'kw1' to utilisation factor k_u (it includes radial field variation and end effects)
label the parallel-style serpentine k_d as a mean-radius approximation
spiral: k_w from EQ-08, not from kdAnalytic

equations.name: Rotor inertia estimate
equations.formula: J = n_R (0.5 m_mag (r_1^2 + r_2^2) + 0.5 m_yoke r_Y^2); m_mag = pi (r_2^2 - r_1^2) l_m alpha_p rho_NdFeB; m_yoke = pi r_Y^2 l_m rho_steel, r_Y = r_2 + 2 mm
equations.source_notes: ring/disc inertia (standard mechanics); densities 7.5 and 7.85 g/cm3 unsourced in engine.js line 2556; yoke = magnet thickness, r_Y = r_2 + 2 mm are Xcoil assumptions
changes: cite NdFeB and steel densities
use the user's rotor inertia when given (Xcoil already does)
equations.label: estimate

equations.name: DRC clearance measurement and acceptance
equations.formula: clearance(a, b) = min distance between discretised centre-line segments - (w_a + w_b)/2 (pads: distance to pad outline); violation iff clearance < rule - eps, eps <= 1e-6 mm (D-006); discretisation error bounded by the sagitta tolerance and subtracted (conservative)
